>## Summary
>
>This PR updates the `golang.org/x/crypto` and `golang.org/x/net` dependencies to versions containing fixes for recently disclosed security vulnerabilities.
>
>## Changes
>
>- Bump `golang.org/x/crypto` from `v0.48.0` to `v0.52.0`
>- Bump `golang.org/x/net` from `v0.51.0` to `v0.55.0`
>- Update related indirect dependencies
>- Run `go mod tidy`
>- Regenerate vendored dependencies
>
>## Motivation
>
>Recent security scans identified vulnerabilities in transitive dependencies used by the IBM Cloud Controller Manager. Updating these dependencies brings in the upstream security fixes and allows downstream consumers to build from a patched commit.
>
